rows.grounds: object of hearing; the immortal essence being described
compound qualifying the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
imperative address directing the listener to attend
compound qualifying the nectar as consisting of the art of desire

items.question: What is the essential nature of the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The listener is commanded to hear about a specific nectar.
This nectar is identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This nectar consists of the art of desire.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true Kaula reality whose essence is the art of desire.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context may admit multiple interpretations.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, which consists of the art of desire.
